description:
Activate Llanowar Tribe by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Seeker of Skybreak by tapping it, targeting Llanowar Tribe.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Seeker of Skybreak's ability, targeting Seeker of Skybreak.
Resolve both Seeker of Skybreak abilities, untapping it and Llanowar Tribe.
Repeat.
